snippets.description: The approved validate contract requires discovery of a local Node/pnpm executable and a disposable fixture before any source edit.
snippets.content: Resolve the actual local Node and pnpm executables; select the runner only from that discovery; create only disposable Postgres, Redis, and fake storage fixtures.

snippets.description: The API package exposes build and start scripts but no test script or test-runner configuration.
snippets.content: scripts contains build, dev, start, and start:prod only.

snippets.description: The contract prohibits live targets and mutable smoke testing.
snippets.content: Do not run test_smoke.ts or use shared/staging/production services; fixture uncertainty is a hard stop.
